MeshCore (vendored subset)
==========================

Upstream:   https://github.com/meshcore-dev/MeshCore
Commit:     e94125987ed87497e706a0b54d1e80c709343980 (main, 2026-09-20)
Release:    newest tag at that commit's time is companion-v1.17.1; library.json says 1.10.0
Licence:    MIT (license.txt). lib/ed25519 is zlib (lib/ed25519/license.txt),
            Copyright (c) 2015 Orson Peters.

Why a subset
------------
Only the core mesh, BaseChatMesh and ed25519 are used. Upstream's own
library.json compiles every helper, including RadioLib wrappers, CommonCLI,
sensors and board support, which pull in RadioLib, RTClib, CayenneLPP and
<target.h>. None of those are wanted here: the radio is driven through
Ratspeak's own SX1262 driver.

Local changes
-------------
- library.json is local (not upstream): it builds only the files below.
- Every other file is byte-identical to the upstream blob at the commit above.
  Verify from this directory with:  sha256sum -c --ignore-missing PROVENANCE.txt
  (only the hash lines below are read; the prose lines are ignored with a warning).

External dependencies (pinned in platformio.ini [tpager_base] lib_deps)
------------------------------------------------------------------------
- rweather/Crypto 0.4.0   AES, SHA256, Ed25519 verify (Utils.cpp, Packet.cpp, Identity.cpp)
- densaugeo/base64 1.4.0  channel PSK decoding (BaseChatMesh.cpp, MAX_GROUP_CHANNELS)
